name: Tiddly-Wink British
description: Tiddly-Wink British is a domino connecting game in the Block family. Players receive tiles from a double-six set (or double-nine or double-twelve for more players), the holder of the largest double leads, and tiles are played on either end of the line with matching ends. Playing a double gives the option of a second tile in the same turn. The winner is the player who dominoes, or the player with the lowest pip count if the game is blocked.
deck: Double-six domino set (double-nine or double-twelve for more players)
